info.title: SIGNAL local API
info.description: Implemented route contract. Better Auth /api/auth/* is handled by Better Auth and documented separately. JSON APIs return no-store and X-Request-ID on ordinary responses. Global public read budget 1200/min; account writes 60/min. No public API-key auth. Authenticate through the same-origin Better Auth session cookie. Generic object responses expose current database field names; detailed schemas remain partial.

get.description: Parameterized full-text search by default. Semantic/hybrid require a signed-in account, pgvector, configured embedding model and indexed data. Historical asOf uses recorded snapshots; semantic history is unsupported. bbox=west,south,east,north supports the dateline. from/to use occurrence time. category accepts comma-separated values. Source filtering uses the primary provider.

get.description: Country associations derive from domestic feed sections or explicit headline terms. Counts cover all stored reports in the selected mode. They do not establish exact event locations. Country filters use ISO alpha-2 codes, e.g. CH or DE.

patch.description: Owner-only. Submit complete values; omitted optional fields reset to schema defaults.

post.description: One validated SSE answer event after generation, not incremental token streaming. With AI_PROVIDER=none returns explicitly labeled source-title retrieval. Account history is persisted with mode/provider context. 10 requests/minute/user.

get.description: Last-Event-ID takes priority over cursor. Without either, starts at current outbox head. Connected/heartbeat plus persisted event.created, event.updated, event.merged, event.corrected. Poll interval and retry 4 seconds; batch 200. Filters synthetic mode. No private notification payloads.
